code='''from collections import deque\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    vals = {v for row in grid for v in row}\n    bg = sorted(vals, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid), reverse=True)[:2]\n    # The two most common colors form the noisy background; other color marks the flood seed.\n    marker = next(v for v in vals if v not in bg)\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    q = deque()\n    seen = set()\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if grid[r][c] == marker:\n                q.append((r,c))\n    while q:\n        r,c=q.popleft()\n        for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):\n            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc]==0:\n                seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))\n    for r,c in seen: out[r][c]=marker\n    return out\n'''
